body:
### Summary

Hello, I am investigating using the uv-pep508 crate directly. I haven't exactly tried to see if/how this would affect uv overall, but I believe it would apply to any package with a 

Requires-Dist of `packageName ; "3.11" in python_version`

The bug is that this marker universally resolves to `True`. If you switch the ordering around, `packageName ; python_version in "3.11"` then uv-pep508 will properly evaluate the current python environment, to see if it matches the constraint


From my AI friends, here's a repro (also repros on main)
```rs
Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "uv-pep508-repro"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
uv-pep508 = { git = "https://github.com/astral-sh/uv", tag = "0.12.6" }
src/main.rs:
use std::str::FromStr;
use uv_pep508::{MarkerEnvironment, MarkerEnvironmentBuilder, MarkerTree};

fn env(python_version: &str) -> MarkerEnvironment {
    MarkerEnvironment::try_from(MarkerEnvironmentBuilder {
        implementation_name: "cpython",
        implementation_version: python_version,
        os_name: "posix",
        platform_machine: "x86_64",
        platform_python_implementation: "CPython",
        platform_release: "",
        platform_system: "",
        platform_version: "",
        python_full_version: python_version,
        python_version,
        sys_platform: "linux",
    })
    .unwrap()
}

fn main() {
    let marker = MarkerTree::from_str(r#""3.11" in python_version"#).unwrap();

    for pv in ["3.9", "3.10", "3.11"] {
        let e = env(pv);
        println!("python_version={pv:<5} -> evaluate() = {}", marker.evaluate(&e, &[]));
    }
}
Actual output
python_version=3.9   -> evaluate() = true
python_version=3.10  -> evaluate() = true
python_version=3.11  -> evaluate() = true
```

Compare that to packaging.marker:
```py
>>> from packaging.markers import Marker
>>> m = Marker('"3.11" in python_version')
>>> m.evaluate({"python_version": "3.9"})
False
>>> m.evaluate({"python_version": "3.10"})
False
>>> m.evaluate({"python_version": "3.11"})
True
```

### Platform

macOS Taho26.1

### Version

0.12.6

### Python version

_No response_
title: uv_pep508 parses value in python_version as universally true
